pylint/checkers/misc.py: The fixme message (W0511) is emitted for a comment that starts with one of the configured note tags (by default FIXME, XXX and TODO) or matches notes-rgx, case-insensitively, when the tag is followed by a colon, whitespace or the end of the comment; the message text is the comment from the tag onward and it is reported at the comment's line and column. A word that only begins with a tag is not a note. With no notes configured nothing is reported. Notes inside docstrings are reported only when check-fixme-in-docstring is enabled, for single-line docstrings and on the right line of each line of a multi-line docstring. A line that cannot be decoded with a declared encoding that does not exist is reported as a syntax-error naming the bad encoding. use-symbolic-message-instead (I0023) is reported for each message a module enabled or disabled by numeric id, naming the symbol to use instead, and only for that module.
